general.title: General Settings
general.description: Configure Brainstorm Hub behavior and Markdown export.

data.smart_formatting: Smart Text Optimization (grammar, capitalization, infinitive formatting)

data_description.allowed_echos: Only these Echos can capture ideas and open Brainstorm by voice. Leave empty to use all Echos.

alexa_skill.title: Alexa Voice Input
alexa_skill.description:
**Native** works without setup: say "Alexa, note ...". Alexa may report an error first, then Brainstorm saves the idea.

**Skill** gives one clean answer: say "Alexa, tell Brainstorm note ...". It needs your own free Alexa skill and a Home Assistant reachable from the internet.

**Both** accepts both ways.

alexa_skill_setup.title: Set up your Alexa skill

data.reset_skill: Create a new secret address and remove the skill link

data_description.reset_skill: Use this if the address leaked or you built a new skill. Copy the new skill code afterwards.

reminders.title: Reminders & Notifications
reminders.description: Choose a section. Everything can be switched on and off separately.

reminder_general.title: On/Off & Channels
reminder_general.description: Choose the services you have set up in Home Assistant. Reminders also fire the event brainstorm_reminder_due for your own automations.

data_description.reminders_enabled: Off stops all reminders, the briefing, the review and everything else in this menu.
data_description.reminder_echos: Used for fixed Echos, as a fallback and for the briefing and review.
data_description.reminder_delay: Only with Alexa: gives you time to react before your phone is notified. 0 sends both at once.
data_description.urgent_delay: Applies to ideas with high or urgent priority that are still open.

reminder_schedule.title: Quiet Hours, Briefing & Weekly Review
reminder_schedule.description: Set the times for each of these separately.

data.digest_presence: Only when someone is detected here
data.review_days: Mention ideas open for more than (days)

data_description.quiet_start: Reminders wait until the quiet hours end. Urgent ideas still reach your notification services, but no Echo speaks.
data_description.digest_presence: Optional: The briefing then waits up to 6 hours after its time until a sensor or person here reports someone.

reminder_lists.title: Rules per List
reminder_lists.description: Lists without a rule use the normal settings. Choose a list to edit its rule.

reminder_list_edit.title: Rule for '{category}'
reminder_list_edit.description: For example, private lists only on the phone, or a list on certain days or at a place.

data.channel: Reminders of this list go to
data.notify: Own notification services for this list
data.schedule_enabled: Send the open ideas on certain days
data.zone_enabled: Send the open ideas at a place

data_description.zone_enabled: Sent once a day when someone arrives there. Needs the switch for places.

reminder_places.title: Places & Coming Home
reminder_places.description: Say for example: erinnere mich wenn ich heimkomme an den Müll, or: erinnere mich wenn ich bei Edeka bin an die Milch.

data_description.default_person: Without a person, anyone arriving there triggers the reminder.

reminder_persons.title: People
reminder_persons.description: Say for example: erinnere Lenja morgen um 8 an den Elternsprechtag. Choose a person to set their channels.

reminder_person_edit.title: Channels for {person}
reminder_person_edit.description: These replace the normal channels for this person.

reminder_extras.title: Calendar, AI & Alexa Reminders
reminder_extras.description: Optional extras, each with its own switch.

data.ai_enabled: Shorten the briefing and review with AI

data_description.calendar_enabled: One way, once per reminder. Later changes are not transferred.
data_description.ai_enabled: Your ideas are sent to the provider of the chosen AI.
data_description.native_reminders: In the Alexa console, also switch on Reminders under Build ➔ Permissions. Alexa then rings itself and Home Assistant does not speak as well.

error.no_public_url: Home Assistant has no public HTTPS address, for example through Home Assistant Cloud. The skill cannot reach it, so use Native mode.
